observed_failures: Wide source/JSON projection with LIMIT reached the 5-second statement timeout on full corpus.
Initial structured-only index did not cover needs_review/all searches.
After all-quality indexing, redundant source-checksum joins still caused row-count underestimation and nested CTE scans for some common structured terms.
resolution: Concurrent all-quality lexical GIN replaced the partial index after real oversized-text vector-size preflight.
Materialize bounded-query lexical matches, select candidate IDs through the durable current ledger, and hydrate only page IDs through every source-identity guard.
Use one repeatable-read/read-only snapshot and bound statement execution to five seconds.
